svg.title: Two plans from the same start: one made step by step falls short, one worked back from the vision gets there.
svg.desc: The same drawing twice. Each starts from today, at the lower left, and each has the same level drawn across its top: where the product needs to be. In the first, planned step by step, each step is planned from the last. The work climbs in two small steps, on time, and ends well below that level. The gap is shaded: on time, still short. In the second, planned from the destination, the vision is named first: it sits on that level, highlighted. A dotted arrow runs back from the vision to today, and the work climbs in two larger steps that land on it.
svg.text: each step planned from the last
